summary: Bailiwick of Guernsey. Parliamentary democracy (states of deliberation).
rulers: King CHARLES III (since 8 September 2022); represented by Lieutenant-Governor Richard CRIPWELL (since 15 February 2022); Chief Minister Lindsay de SAUSMAREZ (since 1 July 2025)
economy: high-income English Channel island economy; strong financial sector but stressed due to COVID-19 disruptions; manufacturing, tourism, and construction industries suffered but expected to recover; stable inflation; maintains independent taxation authority
